sn55.3:1.2: This is Dīghāvu’s only appearance in the Suttas. A fabled wise prince of the same name features in a long Vinaya story ([pli-tv-kd10:2.3.1]()).
sn55.3:1.3: This is also Jotika’s only appearance.
sn55.3:3.1: As well as this set of “four factors of stream-entry”, we find a complementary set ([sn55.5](), [sn55.50]()). In a later text the two are distinguished ([dn33:1.11.108]()).
sn55.3:4.5: The text doesn’t identify the speaker, but the use of _tāta_ shows that it must be Jotika.
